title: Consultant Endocrinologist
description: Job Purpose / Objective Consultant Endocrinologist is fully responsible to provide highest standard of clinical care, practice and expertise in assessment, investigation, diagnosis, treatment & follow up of patients in endocrinology. Physician should actively involve in continuous quality improvement activities of department and hospital to achieve the goals of HMG. Key Responsibilities / Accountabilities Manage the assigned clinics as per the approved rota by the Medical Director. Admit the patients under care whenever indicated within the limits of the approved and assigned privileges. Responsible for the initial assessment, investigation, analysis & interpretation of the clinical findings and test results, arriving at diagnosis, treatment, and re-assessment and follow- up of the patients to reach a final diagnosis. Prescribe, administer medication, therapy, and/or other appropriate care to treat or prevent further complication of the disease. Responsible for explaining procedures and discussing diagnostic results or prescribed treatments with the patients and/or with the authorized attendants. Monitor the patient’s condition and progress and re-evaluate/ re-assessment and treat the patient accordingly. Refer the patient to other consultants/specialists when necessary, also consult, or provide consulting services to, other physicians whenever requested. Undertake daily rounds on Patients admitted under his/her name and any referred patients. Document and ensure completeness of all medical records of the patients as per the policies of the hospital and update on the progress of the patient appropriately. Authenticate the medical records at initial entries and progress notes by logging in with own username and password in Patient Health Records. Review and validate the entries and notes of all junior medical staff in case of patients under his care. Perform diagnostic and/or therapeutic procedures for which the Consultant is privileged for. Approve the completed discharge summary, follow-up plan, medical report of the patients. Assume duties as the Head of the department as and when required by the management. Ensure the implementation of all approved policies, procedures, rules, regulations, protocols, guidelines and clinical pathways that guide and support the provision of clinical services. Direct, supervise and coordinate the activities of specialists, residents, nurses, therapists, assistants and other medical staff involved in patient care. Advise and contribute to the development of policies and procedures as part of the continuous quality improvement program of the department. Serve on Departmental / Hospital Committees as required. Ensure that Islamic Values and Medical Ethics are respected and strictly observed. Responsible to be On-Call as per hospital policy. Attend the Code Blue, whenever applicable, and should be involved in all other emergency codes of the hospital. Provide the Patient Medical reports and information as and when required by the Head of the department or Hospital Administrator/Medical Director of the Hospital. Identify and bring all Medico-Legal Cases to the notice of the management on time in accordance with the hospital policy. Participate in the provision of clinical / academic activities of the hospital. Play an active role in the education of the patient and his/ her family on a healthy lifestyle. Contributes to awareness and education of the community, in general, on issues related to health. Be regular and punctual in the duties assigned as per the schedule Follow all hospital policies and procedures. Obtain informed consent for all patients in accordance with hospital policy for the undertaking of any diagnostic procedure, operation, test or procedure. Participate in, and lead person-centered care initiatives undertaken by HMG. Provide orientation, bedside training and supervision to undergraduate and postgraduate trainees (interns, residents and fellows) as assigned. Participate in self-and others’ education, training and development as applicable and department’s educational activities and training programs of the department. Enrich patient experience with compassion, respect and dignity Perform other applicable task and duties assigned within the realm of his/her knowledge, skills and abilities. Requirements: Education/ Professional Qualification Graduate of Medical School, recognized by the Medical Council of the country of origin. Completion of appropriate internship and residency programs Post-graduate qualifications in the specialty. Experience At least three (3) years of practice in his / her specialty after obtaining the higher degree in a Tertiary Care Hospital. Subspecialty degree or structured subspecialty training preferred. Professional Licensing / Certification / Training Membership, Fellowship and/or Board Certification in respective specialty. Relevant licensure from the country of origin, acceptable to Saudi Commission for Health Specialty and Ministr

title: Consultant Radiologist -SYD
description: Job Purpose / Objective Perform diagnostic procedures, interpret radiographs, ultrasound, and CT and MRI images and perform interventional procedures within limits of the assigned privileges. Key Responsibilities / Accountabilities Support regular performance development reviews to identify individual training needs, set and monitor objectives in line with the needs of the individual and over all objectives. Ensure that the department’s quality management system is developed & maintained. Ensure that appropriate risk management process and documents are in place in line with policies and procedures. Provide advice on the procurement (specifications, choice and evaluation) of equipment which falls within the scope of the hospital. Implement measurements and professional judgment on optimization of image quality and radiation dose, including the resolution of image quality problems. Support and implement research activity and oversee such studies when requested by VPPA of the healthcare group. Attend and represent the department in programs conducted by the Hospital. Maintain good relationship with co-workers and patients, families & friends. Give order for the specific preparation guidelines in special procedures of the patient. As requested may need to travel to other sites for discussion of problem cases, and provide support for the clinical outside of the site when requested. Participate in the quality improvement programs of the radiology services. Support and supervise specialist radiologists in guidance & interpretation. Instruct and assist the technologist produce appropriate views and positioning of patient when unusual or difficult problem arises. Conduct and participates in continuous education of technologist and medical education programs of physicians. Ensure the practice adheres to relevant radiation safety legislation at practice site. Support diagnostic research and technology innovation wherever applicable. Support education & promote training opportunities among fellow radiologist, physicians from other specialties, nurses & other clinical staff. Participate in, and lead person-centered care initiatives undertaken by HMG. Provide orientation, training and supervision to undergraduate and postgraduate trainees (interns, residents and fellows) as assigned. Participate in self-and others’ education, training and development as applicable and department’s educational activities and training programs of the department. Enrich patient experience with compassion, respect and dignity. Perform other related duties that are applicable to radiology department as requested by head of department of radiology. Completion of appropriate internship and residency programs Post-graduate qualifications in the specialty. Experience At least three (3) years of practice in his / her specialty after obtaining the higher degree in a Tertiary Care Hospital. Subspecialty degree or structured subspecialty training preferred. Professional Licensing / Certification / Training Membership, Fellowship and/or Board Certification in respective specialty. Relevant licensure from the country of origin, acceptable to Saudi Commission for Health Specialty and Ministry of Health.

title: Paramedic
description: Job Purpose / Objective Administering emergency medical care to injured and critically ill in an emergency environment or while transporting them to other medical facility as a member of an emergency medical team Key Responsibilities / Accountabilities Provide care in the process of resuscitate patients in an emergency before hospital admission. title: Occupational Therapist
description: Job Purpose / Objective: Plan, organize, and conduct occupational therapy programs within the assigned project that designed to help patients regain physical or mental functioning or adjust to their handicaps Key Responsibilities / Accountabilities: Assess, diagnose, treat, and help to prevent disorders related to speech, language, cognitive-communication, voice, swallowing, and fluency. Assess patient’s communication skills (e.g. articulation, fluency, voice, expressive and receptive language, etc.) for the purpose of identifying communication disorders, determining program eligibility and developing recommendations for treatment. Diagnose and treat language disorders, speech deficits and voice therapy exercise rehabilitation. Perform rigid and flexible laryngeal endoscopic examinations, diagnosing laryngeal disease and treating them. Perform pre and post palatal surgery assessments of velopharyngeal competence by endoscopy and participating in the multidisciplinary team determining optimal intervention. Manage Microlaryngeosurgery (for vocal fold polyps, nodules, Cysts), swallowing disorders, rehabilitating learning disability patients. Collaborate with a variety of groups and/or individuals (e.g. parents, physicians, administration, team members, other professionals, etc.) for the purpose of communicating information, resolving issues and providing services in compliance with established guidelines. Coordinate meetings and processes for patients (e.g. testing/screening etc.) for the purpose of presenting evaluation results, developing treatment plans, and/or providing training to patients/ staff. Develop treatment plans, interventions and/or educational materials for the purpose of minimizing the adverse impact of communication disorders in compliance with regulatory requirements. Instruct assigned support staff for the purpose of providing information on communicative disorders, use of assistive devices and feeding techniques and/or implementing prescribed treatment plans. Instruct eligible patients in the use of appropriate communication technologies (e.g. hearing aids, FM systems, augmentative communication devices, etc.) for the purpose of minimizing the adverse educational impact of communication disorders in accordance with established guidelines and legal requirements. Interpret medical reports within the scope and provide information and/or ensuring that treatment/intervention plans are appropriate. Ensure patients records (e.g. progress reports, activity logs, billing information, treatment plans, required documentation, quarterly reports, screening results, etc.) for the purpose of availability of information as required for reference and/or compliance. Provide speech and language therapy education to patients for the purpose of minimizing the adverse impact of speech and language disorders on their life. Participate in person-centered care initiatives undertaken by HMG. Enrich patient experience with compassion, respect and dignity. Requirements: Education/ Professional Qualification: Educational : Bachelor’s Degree Professional : Occupational Therapy Experience: Minimum of Two (2) years of relevant experience

title: Optometrist
description: Job Purpose / Objective: Primarily examine, diagnose, treat, and manage diseases, injuries, and disorders of the visual system, the eye, and associated structures as well as identify related systemic conditions affecting the eye. Prescribe medications, low vision rehabilitation, vision therapy, spectacle lenses, contact lenses and perform specified surgical procedures Key Responsibilities / Accountabilities: Examine the patient and perform a Comprehensive Dilated Eye Exam. Measure Visual Acuity in each eye for near and distance vision with and without glasses for each patient, and in some patients evaluate Visual Fields and Color Vision and measure the Contrast Sensitivity. Perform both Objective Refraction (most be highly skilled in Retinoscope) and Subjective Refraction and Perform Cycloplegic Refraction as needed using Cycloplegic Agents such as Cyclopentolate. Detection of Binocular Vision Disorders, Accommodative Disorders, and all type of Strabismus, along with their diagnosis and determining the appropriate treatment. Detect Neurological Disorders that Affects the Visual Pathway by evaluation of Pupil Function Contrast Sensitivity, Ocular Motility, Optic Nerve Head and interpretation of Perimetry result and refer the patient to an appropriate physician. Conduct pre-and post-operative examinations in cooperation with the surgeon. Examine, diagnose, identify Ocular Diseases, and master the skills of using the Slit Lamp and its accessories which includes: Conduct a Comprehensive Eye Exam (Anterior and posterior Segment) independently and writing medical report Condense Lenses (90D, 28D 20D) to examine the Fundus and Gonioscopy to examine the Anterior Chamber Angle. Independent use of diagnostic drugs such as Fluorescein dye, Mydriatics, Cycloplegics, and Topical Anesthetics. Measure the Intraocular Pressure by using Goldmann Applanation Tonometry. Removal of superficial foreign bodies from the surface of the eye and Eyelash Epilation and Installing punctum plugs for Dry Eye. Referral to an ophthalmologist when there is or is suspected of one of the following, for example, but not limited to: Diseases of the Retina and Vitreous Body that need surgical intervention such as Retinal Detachment, Macular Hole or Proliferative Diabetic Retinopathy (PDR). Diabetic Retinopathy with Macular Edema or Hemorrhage in the center of vision. Hypertensive Eye Disease and Retinal Venous or Arterial Occlusive Disease. When the patient has emergency Diplopia. Presence of advanced Cataract. Hemorrhage or Inflammation in the Anterior Chamber or the Vitreous. Presence of Corneal Dystrophy or active Keratoconus. Presence of Corneal Laceration with Positive Seidel Test or Conjunctival Laceration more than 1 cm. Presence of Strabismus that needs surgical treatment. For second opinion or when the diagnosis is not confirmed. Referral to physician from other specialties with a request for the necessary analyzes and tests: Refer to the Family Physician when there is one of the signs of Diabetes or high Blood Pressure in the Retina of a patient who has not been diagnosed before. Referral to the Family Physician when anemia is suspected through conjunctival signs. Refer to a Neurologist when there is papilledema. Refer to the Family Physician when it is suspected that the patient has an infectious or immune disease. Arrange stationery supplies and medications from the Pharmacy as and when required. Teach and counsel patients in the preventive aspects of eye care and proper use of eye drops or ointment. Participate in person-centered care initiatives undertaken by HMG. Enrich patient experience with compassion, respect and dignity. Perform other applicable tasks and duties assigned within the realm of his knowledge, skills and abilities. description: Job Purpose / Objective Provide certain support to nursing staff with direct and in-direct patient care within the assigned area. Enrich patient experience with compassion, respect, and dignity. Perform other applicable tasks and duties assigned with the realm of his/her knowledge, skills, and abilities. title: Wound Care Nurse
description: Job Purpose / Objective Provides comprehensive wound care to patients using evidence-based practice. Responsible for assessment, observation, and provision of a safe standard of patient care and evaluation of its results. Provides patient, family and staff education regarding wound management, prevention of pressure ulcers, support surfaces, dressing selections and other therapies, is a resource person for physicians wound team and clinical staff. Participates in performance improvement plan of the organization. Key Responsibilities / Accountabilities Assesses the learning needs of nursing staff and collaborates with the Head Nurse Nursing Education to enhance staff knowledge on dealing with individuals at risk for developing ulcers or with existing ulceration based on clinical practice. Performs wound assessment, reassessment and management for all patients as per policy. This includes neonates, pediatric, geriatric, and the general population. Demonstrates knowledge of the principles of growth and development over the life span and the skills necessary to provide age appropriate care to the patient population being served. Demonstrates thorough knowledge of wound assessment and staging system. Establishes and updates standards of care, competencies, policies and procedures about wound care program to include patient care protocols and documentation tools. Provide training and support in the provision of best updated nursing practice on wound care. Assists the Head/ In-charge Nurses in identifying the need for change in current practice based on the available wound care materials and assists with the implementation of required changes based on needs and nursing care requirements in conjunction with HMG standards and guidelines. Monitors hospital acquired pressure rates and leads the team for conducting Pressure Ulcer Prevalence Survey at least quarterly. Consults other healthcare professionals/departments as appropriate to provide interdisciplinary approach specifically based on the patient’s needs. Revises plan of care as indicated by the patient's response to treatment and evaluates overall plan for effectiveness. Monitors compliance with wound care policy. Participates in the education for and the evaluation of new products, equipment, technology and system processes to improve wound care management. Participates in relevant education programs, in-services and workshops to increase professional competency and meet personal needs and goals. Provides patient, family and staff education regarding wound management, prevention of pressure ulcers, support surfaces, dressing selection and other adjunct therapies. Provides basic wound care training and orientation to all newly hired nursing staff. Reports unsafe practice, professional incompetence, professional misconduct and incapacity or unfitness to practice of any health care team member through appropriate channels. Provides constructive feedback to members of the health care team in a timely manner. Formulates a teaching plan based upon identified staff learning needs and evaluates effectiveness of learning. Facilitates the implementation of new or revised policies and educational programs. Demonstrates professional and educational ethics related to medical practice and patient confidentiality. Assists in identifying patient/family education needs and participates in the development of patient/family education materials. Provide patient and family education as per the needs. Participate in person-centered care initiatives undertaken by HMG. Enrich patient experience with compassion, respect and dignity. Performs other applicable task and duties assigned within the realm of his/ her knowledge, skills and abilities.
